title: 知
teacherNotes: Production A asset-complete-package for L224. Latest origin/main is complete through L223, so L222 改 and L223 錯 are already real learned characters. Production owns request, packet, draft, images, audio, Stage 4 audio, and alignment. Release owns production JSON insertion, planner export, ledger update, final verify, merge, and deploy.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main production JSON through L223 plus current target from newChars
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, and protagonist little girl.
Teacher must be visually distinct from protagonist mother.
Passerby adult must be visually distinct from protagonist mother and teacher.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, names, school names, badges, clothing tags, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 知 as public/assets/lessons/L224/audio/char-u77e5.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 男孩同學做錯事後願意改過，正在把自己弄亂的桌子整理好，主角老師在旁邊溫和鼓勵。老師必須和主角媽媽視覺上不同。畫面要表現「知道錯、願意改」是好事；不可有文字、數字或標籤。
主角媽媽抱著或照顧一個很小的嬰兒，嬰兒天真地看著周圍，表現小小孩還什麼都不知道。畫面可有主角小女孩在旁邊好奇看著，但主要人物是主角媽媽和嬰兒；不可有文字、數字或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 老師看到我做錯事，叫我改過。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 老師看到我做錯事叫我改過
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在教室中做錯事，例如把桌上物品弄亂或拿錯東西，老師看到後溫和提醒她改過。老師必須使用 recurring teacher identity，不能長得像主角媽媽。畫面要表現老師看到、提醒改過的情境；不可有文字、數字、黑板字或標籤。
主角小女孩在安全的路邊或人行道上不知道怎麼走，向一位路人阿姨或路人叔叔問路。路人要使用 varied passerby identity，不可長得像主角媽媽或老師。畫面要有路、人行道、問路姿勢；不可有路牌文字、數字、地圖文字或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 我知道要換校服，也要換校褲。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 我知道要換校服也要換校褲
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩放學回家後，知道要換掉校服和校褲，主角媽媽在旁邊準備家居衣物。畫面只呈現準備更換衣物的安全情境，不呈現更衣過程；校服校褲不可有校名、文字、數字、徽章字樣或標籤。

G01.reason: 「知錯能改」是本課核心用法，目標字清楚。

G05.correctText: 我知道要換校服，也要換校褲。
G05.wrongOneText: 我知道要換校服，也要穿校褲。
G05.wrongTwoText: 我知道要穿校服，也要換校褲。
